projectDescription: A PowerShell toolkit that lets Codex and AI agents automate Microsoft Project 2019 on Windows — creating and editing .mpp schedules via XML/COM, verifying saved files, and exporting full-schedule tables and Gantt charts to PNG without screen scrolling.
keyFeatures: Bulk XML import for fast schedule creation (120 tasks in ~9s) with an explicit Monday–Friday 8h/day calendar
COM automation via Windows PowerShell 5.1 STA for targeted edits to existing .mpp files by UniqueID
Native GIF → PNG export of the full task table and/or Gantt chart without screen scrolling, using Project's built-in EditCopyPicture
Pixel-identical GIF-to-PNG conversion with SHA-256 verification and animated-GIF rejection
Bulk XML snapshot for verification instead of thousands of individual COM property reads
Safe copy-before-write workflow: UpdateCopy never touches the original source file (hash-verified)
GDI screen capture for live Project window screenshots when interface evidence is required
Structured JSON input/output for all operations with strict preflight validation (null, boolean, cycle detection)
Session journal (Project-View Open/Restore) for auditable open/close of project files
Environment preflight check (Test-ProjectEnvironment) reporting PS version, apartment state, and COM availability
